All /api/loadboard-gateway endpoints work (boards registry with 5 boards, per-board test -> no_credentials, unknown board -> 404, ingest+dedup, feed with fingerprint/sources, outbox list with html excluded, flush returns sent=0 without Resend key, actions with 'queued' mode, autopilot E2E booking creates outbox+board_actions doc with SIM- board_id sourcing, gateway status chain has 6 entries incl internal_sim, self-repair sweep OK, ops-backups OK, /api/connections/providers includes convoy). Frontend: /resilience -> rc-tab-gateway renders LoadBoardCommand with 5 board cards (all NO KEYS), lbc-test-dat toasts no_credentials, lbc-ingest-btn/lbc-flush-btn work, feed/outbox/actions panels render, QUEUED chips present, all 4 regression tabs (sentinel/engine/runbook/backups) still render. One legitimate backend bug found: the `truckstop` provider in /api/connections/providers is MISSING the `booking_email` field (all 4 other boards dat/loadboard_123/uber_freight/convoy have it).

critical.issue: Truckstop provider is missing the `booking_email` field. Its fields are only [client_id, client_secret, integration_id]. Per spec, booking_email should exist on ALL 5 load-board providers (dat/truckstop/loadboard_123/uber_freight/convoy). Without it users cannot save a truckstop booking desk email, so the email-fallback booking path is broken for that board.

action_items: Add `booking_email` field to the `truckstop` provider in /app/backend/routes/connections.py PROVIDERS registry so it matches dat/loadboard_123/uber_freight/convoy.
critical_code_review_comments: loadboard_gateway.py line 288: sim fill only triggers when `not batches and open_count < SIM_FEED_FLOOR`. If a live board later returns even 1 load but total open feed is under floor, the sim safety-net will NOT fire — could shrink the feed. Consider: `if open_count < SIM_FEED_FLOOR: batches.extend(_sim_loads(...))`.

book_on_board() catches Exception from the accept POST and benches the board but then falls through to _send_or_queue_email — good. However it never records an 'api_failed' board_action, so the api-attempt is silent in the actions timeline until the queued/email entry appears. Consider a debug action row for observability.

_fingerprint bucketizes rate at $50 granularity — fine for dedup, but the 'highest rate wins' merge only updates rate/board/board_id, not miles/commodity. If two boards disagree on miles, we keep the older value silently.
flush_outbox() will silently skip items with no board and no to_email — those remain queued forever. Should mark as 'orphaned' after N retries.
/api/loadboard-gateway/outbox returns up to 50 rows; no pagination. Fine for now but note for scale.
seed_data_creation: One autopilot run-cycle executed during E2E test (daily_limit temporarily bumped to 18 then restored to 15). Autopilot remains ENABLED per instructions.

Outbox already has queued items from prior iters — do not delete.
rca of the issue: The connections.PROVIDERS entry for truckstop was not updated when booking_email fields were added to the other 4 boards. Simply append `{'key':'booking_email','label':'Booking Desk Email','secret': false, 'required': false}` (or match the same shape used by the other four boards) to truckstop's fields list. Then get_connection_credentials will surface booking_email and book_on_board() email fallback for the Truckstop.com board will work identically to the others.
